entities.name: Maximum number of active EPS bearer contexts
entities.description: The maximum number of simultaneously active EPS bearer contexts in a PLMN is determined by the lowest of: protocol maximum (15 in current version), PLMN's maximum in S1 mode, and UE implementation-specific maximum.

entities.name: UE Network Capability IE
entities.description: Information Element used by UE to indicate support for maximum 15 EPS bearer contexts via the 15 bearers bit.

entities.name: EPS network feature support IE
entities.description: Information Element used by network to indicate support for maximum 15 EPS bearer contexts via the 15 bearers bit.

entities.name: NB-S1 mode user plane radio bearer limit
entities.description: In NB-S1 mode, UE's implementation-specific maximum number of active user plane radio bearers is 2 when Multiple DRB support bit is set, otherwise 1.

entities.name: Inter-system change from N1 mode to NB-S1 mode
entities.description: Condition triggering local deactivation of default EPS bearer contexts when number exceeds UE's maximum user plane radio bearers and UE is using user plane CIoT EPS optimization.

entities.name: EPS bearer context status IE
entities.description: Information Element included in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message to indicate EPS bearer context status after local deactivation.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used during tracking area updating procedure, carries EPS bearer context status IE.

entities.name: UE requested PDN disconnection procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to disconnect PDN connections during inter-system change.

entities.name: UE requested PDN connectivity procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to establish PDN connections after inter-system change.

relations.description: UE indicates support for 15 EPS bearer contexts via 15 bearers bit in UE Network Capability IE.
Network indicates support for 15 EPS bearer contexts via 15 bearers bit in EPS network feature support IE.
Inter-system change condition triggers inclusion of EPS bearer context status IE in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message contains EPS bearer context status IE.
Inter-system change condition may trigger UE requested PDN disconnection procedure.
Inter-system change condition may trigger UE requested PDN connectivity procedure.
